diffucd.title: Bearing fault diagnostic framework under unknown working conditions based on condition-guided diffusion model
diffucd.architecture: Three encoder self-attention blocks, three decoder cross-attention blocks, three-layer numerical condition encoder with timestep input, skip-connected UNet
diffucd.implementation_choices: 1D channels 32/64/128/256, four attention heads, 128-dimensional condition embeddings; widths are port choices because the article does not specify them
diffucd.filter_port: Per requested state and condition, retain the prescribed number nearest the generated cluster mean. The paper also describes high/low-dimensional KL probabilities without a fully specified embedding implementation; this port uses its stated nearest-cluster-center selection rule.

ccgan.port: 1D residual conditional-BN generator and spectral-normalized projection discriminator; signal-to-label and label-to-embedding pretraining; soft vicinal hinge GAN. Multiple physical parameters use Euclidean neighborhoods within the same device/channel/fault state.

iccdm.port: Execute the upstream matrix-form EDM and Heun sampler. A 32x32 carrier reshapes to 1024 samples before every 1D convolution; it introduces no 2D waveform neighborhoods. Learned covariance and conditional embeddings receive their own auxiliary training. Adaptive multidimensional vicinal neighborhoods retain device/channel/fault identity.

time_weaver.port: Execute the native patched TimeWeaverCore, three 64-channel residual attention blocks, patch width four and 50-step quadratic beta schedule; continuous physical fields and multi-hot faults replace discrete-only attribute lookup.

flowts.port: Execute the native encoder/decoder, trend and Fourier-seasonal paths with 3 encoder and 6 decoder layers, width 64 and four heads. Add a continuous condition projection in latent space. Retain linear flow objective, time scale 1000, alpha-three shifted Euler grid. SDPA replaces mathematically identical explicit attention products; unused attention maps are omitted.
